A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Promethium (프로메튬) itself — the sovereign of the Promethium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; oval face; almond-shaped eyes of natural size; amber eyes; straight brows of natural fullness; a nose with a soft, rounded tip, of natural size; medium-full lips of natural width.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; a short asymmetrical undercut with swept bangs; warm rose-copper hair whose ends glow a soft pale blue-green on their own, like self-luminous paint.
Expression: a small sly smile, bright eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: promethium: the long-missing element 61, a gap in the table foretold for decades and falsely claimed again and again, never truly found in nature because not one of its forms is stable; finally caught in 1945 in the ashes of split uranium inside a wartime reactor laboratory and named for the titan who stole fire from the gods and gave it to people, a reminder of both daring and danger; its pink salts glow on their own a pale blue-green in the dark, so it became the self-luminous paint on watch hands and signs, and the tiny atomic battery that kept early heart pacemakers beating for years without light or fuel.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Minimal thin charcoal-grey armor with pale blue-green self-luminous lines painted along its edges, large thrusters at the calves and ankles flaring ember orange, a light, fast, forward-leaning line, a small sealed ember-cell glowing at the chest like a stolen flame, soft rose accents at the joints; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Design idea: Thin rose armor layers sandwich luminous turquoise channels around the torso, like self-powered phosphor cells with exposed glowing cross-sections.
Colours: self-glow pale blue-green, stolen-ember orange, smoky charcoal, soft promethium-salt rose.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a mountain of ember relays: from a fusion-reactor city on the summit, runners carry sealed glowing ember-cells down a long cliffside track marked with self-luminous blue-green lines to the dark settlements in the valleys, past relay towers where the cells are handed on.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Pm) and atomic number (61) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
